plateaus: Exported Russian technology does not prove Russian operational command.
No synchronized multi-country common control plane is established.
Russian remote operational control of sovereign foreign deployments remains unproven.

current_defensible_warning: Russia has demonstrated an integrated model in Crimea in which information-distribution control, source substitution, suppression of alternative reporting and high-volume narrative operations operated in the same political-military window. Russian-origin DPI/SORM has also proliferated abroad and Russian DPI has been publicly reported as used for targeted filtering in Kazakhstan. These facts justify proactive monitoring for similar cross-domain activation, but do not establish a current global TSPU campaign or remote Russian command of sovereign third-country systems.
highest_value_missing_evidence: Remote-management/control-plane evidence linking sovereign foreign deployments to Russian actors.
Reproducible synchronized multi-country technical fingerprints above an independent-censorship null model.
Path-localized effect on access to U.S./open information with matched bypass/control routes.
Frequency-by-frequency Crimea FM reconstruction for the first weeks of March 2014.
